name: Award applications admitted
definition: Reward applications an authority formally admitted for consideration (e.g. Hungarian GVH 'befogadott kérelem'), as opposed to all inquiries or applications received.
notes: proposed by research:uk-europe. Proposed for the Hungarian GVH informant reward; could instead be a breakdown of award_applications_received.

name: Award applications received
definition: Applications or requests for a reward filed by whistleblowers with the programme in a period (distinct from tips).
notes: proposed by research:international. Slovakia (requests for a reward to the Whistleblower Protection Office), Lithuania (requests for a reward for valuable information).

name: Award claims denied
definition: Award claims or applications denied or rejected in a period (final determinations).

name: Award claims received
definition: Applications for a whistleblower award (e.g. SEC/CFTC Form WB-APP) received by the programme in a period, as the source counts them.
notes: proposed by research:sec-cftc. Distinct from tips_received (tips) and claims_closed (decided claims). Proposed by sec-cftc pass.

name: Awards accrued (determined, not yet paid)
definition: Whistleblower awards the programme has recorded as probable liabilities (contingent claims accrued) or preliminarily determined in a period or at a date, before payment; breakdown item= says which (e.g. item=preliminary_determinations).
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC fund table line 'contingent claims to Fund resources accrued'; needed so the fund table adds up).

name: Awards paid (amount)
definition: Total money paid to whistleblowers as awards in a period.

name: Awards paid (number)
definition: Number of awards paid (or made, if the source does not distinguish) in a period. Say in notes whether paid or merely determined.

name: Cases handled by a whistleblower authority
definition: Cases, files or matters a whistleblower protection authority dealt with in a period, as the source counts them (breakdown says scope, type or unit).
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority (Slovak Whistleblower Protection Office reports).

name: Claims closed
definition: Whistleblower claims or tips closed in a period, for any reason (award, denial, rejection, no action).

name: Open claims (inventory)
definition: Whistleblower claims, submissions or taxpayers still open (not closed) at a date, as the source counts them (say in notes whether submissions, claim numbers or taxpayers).
notes: proposed by research:irs. Needed for the IRS backlog: annual reports print open-inventory tables by status. Unit says what is counted.

name: Claims referred for examination
definition: Whistleblower claims (or tips) that the agency sent to field examination or investigation in a period, as the source counts them.
notes: proposed by research:irs. IRS annual reports from FY2018 print receipts selected for referral to field examination (Table 2B), a measure of how many tips are actually acted on.

name: Money collected thanks to whistleblowers
definition: Taxes, sanctions, penalties or other money collected by the government in cases where a whistleblower's information was used, in a period.

name: Compliance inspections
definition: Inspections by a whistleblower authority of employers' compliance (internal reporting systems, treatment of whistleblowers) in a period.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Document requests reviewed to protect whistleblower identity
definition: Requests to produce or share enforcement documents that a whistleblower office reviewed in a period to protect whistleblower confidentiality; breakdown requester= (enforcement_litigation, other_agencies) and scope= (all, involving_whistleblowers, identifying_information).
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC annual reports from FY2017).

name: Employer requests to act against a protected whistleblower
definition: Employer requests for the authority's consent to a labour-law act against a protected whistleblower, decided or received in a period; breakdown gives outcome.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Fines imposed for breaching whistleblower law
definition: Fines imposed by a whistleblower authority on employers or persons for breaching whistleblower-protection law (amount, or count with unit fines); breakdown item= names the target when published.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Share of enforcement matters involving whistleblowers
definition: Share of an agency's enforcement matters (investigations or actions) that involve or originate with whistleblowers, as the source states it.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC FY2024 report: 'About 42% of the CFTC's enforcement matters involve whistleblowers').

name: People or calls contacting the authority
definition: People who contacted a whistleblower authority, or helpline calls (breakdown channel=helpline), in a period.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Forecast Exchequer yield of a reward measure
definition: Official forecast of the extra net tax revenue a reward measure is expected to bring in a future year (e.g. a costing certified by a fiscal council). Always status projection.
notes: proposed by research:uk-europe. Proposed for the UK Budget 2025 costing of the Strengthened Reward Scheme.

name: Non-qui tam fraud matters opened
definition: New False Claims Act matters opened by the government itself (referrals and investigations not started by a whistleblower suit) in a period, as counted by the DOJ Civil Division ("New matters - non qui tam").
notes: proposed by research:false-claims-act. Context for qui_tam_suits_filed: shows what share of new FCA matters come from whistleblowers.

name: Balance of the reward fund
definition: Balance of a dedicated fund that pays awards (e.g. the SEC Investor Protection Fund) at a date.

name: Deposits into the reward fund
definition: Money deposited into or credited to a dedicated whistleblower reward fund (e.g. CFTC Customer Protection Fund, SEC Investor Protection Fund) in a period, from collected sanctions.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority (CFTC FY2011 report, statutory report item).

name: Investment earnings of the reward fund
definition: Earnings on investments of a dedicated whistleblower reward fund in a period.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority (CFTC FY2011 report, statutory report item).

name: Other payments from the reward fund
definition: Money paid or incurred from a dedicated whistleblower reward fund for purposes other than awards in a period (e.g. customer education, administrative expenses of the whistleblower office); breakdown item= says which, and whether paid or incurred but unpaid.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC Customer Protection Fund statutory table; needed so the fund table can be checked).

name: Individuals awarded
definition: Number of distinct individuals who received an award in a period or since launch.

name: Informant reward contracts signed
definition: Number of reward contracts or agreements the agency has signed with informants (cumulative or in a period).
notes: proposed by research:international. Canada CRA OTIP, where a reward requires a signed contract.

name: Notices of Covered Action posted
definition: Notices of Covered Action (NCAs) a programme posts in a period: enforcement actions whose sanctions pass the award threshold, opening a window for award claims (SEC/CFTC).
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC annual reports print NCAs posted each year).

name: Time to decide a claim
definition: Average or median time from claim to award decision or payment, as the source defines it (say which in notes).

name: Protected whistleblower statuses granted
definition: Whistleblowers (or statuses) granted formal protected status in a period (e.g. Slovak 'status chráneného oznamovateľa').
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Requests for protective measures
definition: Requests by whistleblowers for a protective measure (e.g. suspension of an employer's act, protected status) handled in a period; breakdown gives measure and outcome.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Whistleblowers given psychosocial or career support
definition: Whistleblowers who used support services (psychological, career) provided by an authority in a period.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Qui tam lawsuits filed
definition: New False Claims Act (or similar) lawsuits filed by whistleblowers (relators) in a period.

name: Recoveries in cases not brought by whistleblowers
definition: Money recovered (settlements and judgments) in cases that did not originate in a whistleblower (qui tam) suit, in a period.
notes: proposed by research:false-claims-act. DOJ FCA table column "Settlements and judgments - non qui tam". Has a series break at FY2020 (U.S. Attorneys' Office matters added).

name: Total recoveries
definition: All money recovered by the government under the law in a period (settlements and judgments), whistleblower cases or not.

name: Recoveries in whistleblower cases
definition: Money recovered in cases brought or prompted by a whistleblower (qui tam), in a period.

name: Payments to relators
definition: Money paid or awarded to whistleblowers (relators) as their share of qui tam recoveries in a period.

name: Respondents sanctioned in whistleblower cases
definition: Number of respondents (persons or companies) against whom successful enforcement action was taken in matters where whistleblower information contributed, in a period or to date.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-can1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-can1 (OSC: '19 respondents'). Companion to sanctions_ordered.

name: Sanctions ordered in whistleblower cases
definition: Monetary sanctions ordered (not necessarily collected) in enforcement actions that used whistleblower information.

name: Taxes assessed thanks to whistleblowers
definition: Additional tax assessed (or identified as owing) in cases using informants' information, whether or not collected.
notes: proposed by research:international. Separate from collections_attributable (money actually collected).

name: Countries tips came from
definition: Number of countries from which a programme received tips in a period or to date.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-can1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-can1 (OSC: tips from 30 countries). SEC/CFTC annual reports print similar counts.

name: Whistleblower tips or submissions received
definition: Tips, submissions or claims received by the programme in a period, as the source counts them (say in notes whether by submission, by claim or by person).
